source: USDA NRCS AWDB SNOTEL Network & NOAA CPC Oceanic Niño Index (ONI)

PNW.name: Pacific Northwest & Cascades
PNW.description: Maritime to transitional snowpack across Washington, Oregon, and the Cascade Range (HUC 17 West).

SIERRA.name: Sierra Nevada & California
SIERRA.description: High-relief maritime snowpack in the California/Tahoe Sierra Nevada and Klamath mountains (HUC 18).

GREAT_BASIN.name: Great Basin & Wasatch
GREAT_BASIN.description: High-desert mountain ranges and Wasatch/Uinta snowsheds in Nevada and Utah (HUC 16).

NORTHERN_ROCKIES.name: Northern Rockies & Columbia Headwaters
NORTHERN_ROCKIES.description: Continental and transitional mountain ranges of Idaho, Montana, and Northern Wyoming.

CENTRAL_ROCKIES.name: Upper Colorado & Central Rockies
CENTRAL_ROCKIES.description: High-elevation continental headwaters of the Colorado, Green, Platte, and Wind River basins.

SOUTHWEST.name: Southwest & Rio Grande
SOUTHWEST.description: Southern Rockies, Mogollon Rim, and Rio Grande headwaters in Arizona and New Mexico (HUC 13 & 15).

ALASKA.name: Alaska & Subarctic
ALASKA.description: Coastal maritime and interior subarctic snow monitoring network across Alaska (HUC 19).
